Handling time and delivery time on Cartwheel are generally separate components. 

1. **Handling Time**: This is the time it takes for a store to process your order before it is shipped. It includes order confirmation, packing, and preparing for shipment.

2. **Delivery Time**: This begins once the order has been shipped and is the time it takes for the package to reach your address.

When you're estimating the total shipping time, you typically add the handling time to the delivery time. So, for a complete estimate, consider both these durations together.
